notes: Themed rounds, styling and a voted catwalk make this the Dress Up subgenre of Roleplay & Avatar Sim, and there is no housing model to choose since personalization is entirely through the avatar. Took the preset's own stage-runway unchanged: the answers put a compact central runway plaza at the middle with boutiques, cafes, photo spots, gardens and portals arranged around it, which is a catwalk fed by preparation space with the audience around it, on one continuous map rather than a separate show map, so no P4. P3 is required rather than assumed because players physically walk into each boutique to browse mannequins and into the VIP district behind the golden gates, and the city itself is carried by settlement-density, path-street and district-zoned rather than by the shape. Decided without a user: private per-player booths are treated as instanced interiors of that same map rather than separate maps, voting and ranks are gameplay, and fashion quests and hidden collectibles have no option in this genre's table, so they are recorded here as unmapped requests; P3 is not a live modifier yet, so facade-only shops would be the fallback if this must build today.
